To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the production of teicoplanins was enhanced by the use of valine analogue-resistant mutants.
the valine analogue-resistant mutants of Actinoplanetes teichomycetius overproduced the major teicoplanin component, teicplanin A2-1, and that the total productivity was 1,500 units/ml..
a valine analogue-resistant strain of Actinoplanetes teichomycetius produced teicoplanin at higher levels with higher A2–2 content than the parent strain..
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and characterization of a new glycopeptide antibiotic, teicoplanine A2-2.
the isolation and characterization of a valine analogue-resistant, valine overproducing mutant of A. teichomycoticus, which overproduces teicoplanin.
the production of teicoplanins, glycopeptide antibiotics, by a valine analogue-resistant strain of Actinoplanetes teichomycetius.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
valine analogue-resistant mutants of A. teichomycetius overproduced valines, and this resulted in the production of a higher titer and content of teicoplanins, especially of the major component.
the production of the major teicoplanin component, teicoplani A2-2 by valine analogue resistant mutants was improved.

the valine hydroxamate-resistant mutant strain of Actinoplanetes teichomycetica 98-1, which was isolated by a random mutation procedure and was found to be a producer of teicoplanins with a higher A2- 2 content, was a valuable strain for the industrial production of teicoplanines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a strain improvement for the overproduction of valine and teicoplanin in Actinoplanes sp. resulted in a higher productivity of the major teicoplanin component.
a valine analogue-resistant strain of A. teichomycetius was obtained by chemical mutagenesis and that the strain overproduces the major component, A2-2.
valine analogue-resistant mutants of A. teichomycetcus can be used as a production strain of teicoplanins, especially of the major component A2-2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
valine analog resistant mutants of Actinoplanetes can be used for the production of teicoplanins.
valine analogue-resistant mutants can be useful for the improvement of the production of teicoplanins.
valine hydroxamate-resistant strains can be used for the production of teicoplanins with a higher A2-1/A2-2 ratio.
